title: 第7章 逃离皇宫第8章 追赶家人
lines: “传令下去，开启皇宫和皇城大阵，且不能让那刺客有任何逃跑的机会！
还有，传令给皇城守军，紧守城门，连一只蚊子都不准给朕放出去！”
命令下达，整个皇宫四周城墙上，一道道光芒直冲云霄。
皇宫之外，皇城守军也开始动了起来，四个城门被围的水泄不通。
皇城城墙上，同样升起光柱，形成阵法光罩，将整个皇城包围了起来。
“不好，他们开启了阵法！”
楚峰看着不远处的皇宫城墙，脸色顿时有些难看了起来。
他没想到这短短不过一炷香时间，这皇宫竟然直接开启了阵法。
“小子，先去那城墙之上，伺机而动！”
楚峰脚步不停，直奔城墙而去。
“守卫太子东宫的御林军统领何在？”
命令下达之后，大夏国皇帝便召见那位御林军统领。
“陛下，老臣这便将他带来。”
没多久之后，老者便带着那位御林军统领来到了大夏国皇帝面前。
“属下无能，未曾发现刺客行踪，愿以死谢罪！”
那位统领匍匐在地，等待着死亡的审判。
同时，他心里对楚峰怨恨到了极致。
对方一件破衣服和鞋子，耍的自己团团转。
害得自己犯下大错。
“陛下，马统领固然有罪，但是却罪不至死，还请陛下给他一个戴罪立功的机会！”
老者连忙求情道。
“哼，看在老师的面上，暂且饶你一命，不过，死罪可免，活罪难逃。
革去你御林军统领一职，前去追捕那名刺客，抓不到刺客，你，就不用回来了。”
“多谢陛下开恩！”
马统领退走了。
“可恶，老子一定要抓住你！”
马统领脱掉身上的铠甲，前往皇宫一处。
他已经想好了办法，如何去追捕那名刺客了。
“陛下，按照马江所说，那名刺客的修为并不高，之所以能够隐身，怕是借助了宝物之力。”
老者说道。
“如果真是宝物，那此等宝物怕是价值非凡。”
能够躲过元海境的精神力探查，这宝物的等级怕也不会低于四品了。
就在这时，几人听到了下方传来一阵阵狗叫声。
“哦？寻灵犬，没想到马江竟然会想到这样的办法！”
寻灵犬，他们自然知晓。
它可以根据气味追踪对方的行踪。
比起普通的狗，要灵敏得多。
精神力无法探查的地方，这寻灵犬或许真的会有发现也说不定。
“老师，我们就守在这里，等那人现身！”
content_en:
"Give the order, activate the palace and imperial city formations, and don't let the assassin have any chance to escape!
Also, send an order to the imperial city defenders to guard the city gate tightly. I am not allowed to let even a mosquito out! "
After the order was issued, rays of light shot straight into the sky on the walls surrounding the palace.
Outside the palace, the imperial city defenders also began to move, and the four city gates were surrounded by water.
On the walls of the Imperial City, pillars of light also rose, forming a formation of light and surrounding the entire Imperial City.
"No, they activated the formation!"
Chu Feng looked at the palace wall not far away, and his expression suddenly turned ugly.
He didn't expect that in just one stick of incense time, the palace would activate the formation directly.
"Boy, go to the city wall first and wait for the opportunity!"
Chu Feng kept walking and headed straight for the city wall.
"Where is the commander of the imperial army guarding the prince's east palace?"
After the order was issued, the Emperor of Daxia summoned the commander of the Royal Forest Army.
"Your Majesty, I will bring him here."
Not long after, the old man brought the commander of the Royal Forest Army to the Emperor of Great Xia.
"My subordinates are incompetent and have never discovered the whereabouts of the assassin. I am willing to die to apologize!"
The commander prostrates himself on the ground, waiting for the judgment of death.
At the same time, he resented Chu Feng to the extreme.
The other party had a piece of tattered clothes and shoes, and was making a fool of himself.
Causing yourself to make a big mistake.
"Your Majesty, although Commander Ma is guilty, his crime will not lead to death. Please give him a chance to make meritorious service!"
The old man quickly begged for mercy.
"Hmph, for the sake of the teacher, I will spare your life for the time being, but you can avoid the death penalty, but you cannot escape the living penalty.
Removing your position as the commander of the Royal Forest Army and going to hunt down the assassin. If you can't catch the assassin, you don't have to come back. "
"Thank you for your mercy, Your Majesty!"
Commander Ma retreated.
"Damn it, I must catch you!"
Commander Ma took off his armor and headed to the palace.
He had already figured out how to hunt down the assassin.
"Your Majesty, according to what Ma Jiang said, the assassin's cultivation level is not high. The reason why he is able to become invisible is probably with the help of the treasure."
The old man said.
"If they are truly treasures, then these treasures are probably extremely valuable."
If it can evade the mental detection of Yuan Hai Realm, the level of this treasure will probably not be lower than the fourth grade.
At this moment, several people heard the sound of dogs barking from below.
"Oh? Soul-hunting dog, I didn't expect Ma Jiang to think of such a method!"
Spiritual dogs, they naturally know.
It can track each other's whereabouts based on scent.
Much more sensitive than ordinary dogs.
In places that cannot be explored with mental power, this spirit hunting dog may actually find something.
"Teacher, let's stay here and wait for that person to show up!"
